solves.reason: ReThink detects potentially hurtful text messages before sent; a message like 'I hate you' contains offensive language; Trisha decided to prevent cyberbullying. => hurtful - offensive - prevent

During Ebola outbreak, Kelvin's radio station providing educational programs was valuable/helpful => invaluable; he improved lives by providing affordable resources (context is positive help to community) => invaluable - improved - affordable

Nonprofit helps people move from homelessness to stable (permanent) housing; furniture 'can restore the dignity of a family' (positive quote); three activists made significant contributions => stable - restore - significant
She read the 'joyful' news of a girl who was cyberbullied for over a year and a half — this is clearly tragic news, not joyful. ①innovative, ②detect, ④created all fit normally.

He experimented with 'brand-new electronics' found in trash cans — trash cans contain discarded/old items, not brand-new ones, so this word usage is inappropriate. ①fascinated, ③educational, ④constructed all fit.

'Furniture can destroy the dignity of a family' contradicts the positive tone of the whole passage (helping homeless people, restoring lives); should be 'restore' not 'destroy'. ①volunteered, ②donations, ③settled all fit.
'young people are already working toward __________ for the problems their communities and the world are facing' — working toward solutions for problems is the logical fit.
'has successfully raised __________ on cyberbullying' — collocation 'raise awareness' matches the app's purpose of alerting users to harmful language.
'constructed a windmill to supply __________ to his community' — a windmill generates electricity/power, consistent with the earlier mention of 'battery capable of powering homes'.
'fighting cyberbullying' means actively combating/battling it => battling is closest in meaning.
'pause and reconsider their words' means to think again/rethink before sending => rethink.
'He invented a battery...' means he devised/created it => devised is closest synonym.
'With schools closed' — the opposite of closed is open.
'helped young people make better decisions' — opposite of better is worse.
(A) 'a generator that runs on salt water' = operates/works using power source => 작동하다. (B) 'Kelvin runs along the beach' = physically running => 달리다. So order is 작동하다-달리다.
'a person who works hard to bring about social or political change' is the definition of an activist (matches John Michael Stagliano, 'a young social activist').
Present perfect construction 'has successfully __________ awareness' requires past participle of 'raise' => raised.

Sentence structure: '__________ donations to gather essential items to help them, John reached out to his family...' is a participial phrase modifying the main clause subject 'John' — present participle 'Needing' (since John needs donations, active voice, ongoing reason).

'inspiration for young people... to pursue their passions and __________ in their communities' — matches the theme of the whole passage (young change-makers who make a difference) => make a difference.
'Needing donations..., John __________ to his family, friends, and neighbors. As word of his efforts spread, donations began to rush in.' — he contacted them for help => reached out.
